requirement: This code should implement a FUNCTION_BLOCK named Motor with methods to control and manage the state of a motor based on input signals and internal timers. The block should handle inputs of type MotorI and outputs of type MotorO. Key methods include SetFault, ResetFault, SetWaitTime, TurnOff, and TurnOn. SetFault sets the fault status to TRUE and turns off the motor if MotorI.Overload is TRUE. ResetFault resets the fault status to FALSE when a rising edge on MotorI.FaultReset is detected. SetWaitTime sets an internal delay time for operations. TurnOff and TurnOn control the motor's operational state, with TurnOn checking for no faults and using a timer to delay the motor start. The implementation should manage timing using a TON timer, and handle transitions and state changes based on the input conditions.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK Motor
VAR_INPUT
	MotorI:MotorI;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	MotorO:MotorO;
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个名为 Motor 的 FUNCTION_BLOCK，包含基于输入信号和内部定时器来控制和管理电机状态的方法。该块应处理类型为 MotorI 的输入和类型为 MotorO 的输出。关键方法包括 SetFault、ResetFault、SetWaitTime、TurnOff 和 TurnOn。SetFault 在 MotorI.Overload 为 TRUE 时将故障状态设置为 TRUE 并关闭电机。ResetFault 在检测到 MotorI.FaultReset 上升沿时将故障状态重置为 FALSE。SetWaitTime 用于设置操作的内部延迟时间。TurnOff 和 TurnOn 控制电机的运行状态，TurnOn 在没有故障的情况下检查，并使用定时器延迟电机启动。实现应使用 TON 定时器管理定时，并根据输入条件处理转换和状态变化。
